title: Piper Sandler names 5 software stocks cutting AI token costs
excerpt: For most of the past two years, investors bought nearly every company tied to semiconductors, from chip designers to equipment makers, and those stocks rose...
content_html:
For most of the past two years, investors bought nearly every company tied to semiconductors, from chip designers to equipment makers, and those stocks rose across the board.

Enterprise software, on the other hand, got treated as collateral damage, priced as though large language models would eventually make the whole category redundant.

That assumption is now getting tested, and not by the software companies themselves.

Piper Sandler told clients on Wednesday that five infrastructure software names are positioned to solve the problem chief information officers complain about most: Running AI agents at scale costs far more than anyone budgeted.

Piper Sandler's argument is that the customer data these companies already store can cut the number of tokens an AI agent needs to process, which lowers the cost of running it.

Why Piper Sandler says these 5 software stocks cut AI token costs

The note, led by analyst Rob Owens, named Elastic (ESTC), GitLab (GTLB), MongoDB (MDB), Snowflake (SNOW), and Atlassian (TEAM) as the primary beneficiaries, Investing.com reported.

A token is a chunk of text that is often smaller than a word. AI models charge by the token, counting both what you send in and what you get back.

Related: AI is quietly changing how portfolios are managed

Owens wrote that the proprietary data already sitting inside these platforms can make models "significantly more accurate and efficient while dramatically reducing token usage costs." 

That will let companies expand AI adoption without costs rising too much.

Early deployments showed token usage falling by 50% to 75% when clean organizational context was fed directly to the agent.

The mechanism is simple enough. AI uses fewer tokens and answers faster when given clean, organized data instead of messy data.

The token math that changed enterprise AI budgets in 2026

Here is the part that confused a lot of investors this year: Token prices fell, yet AI bills went up anyway.

Owens noted that output tokens on newer frontier models run about 50% cheaper than the prior generation, yet improved reasoning capabilities caused consumption to increase.

Reasoning models think in tokens, so a single query that once cost a few hundred tokens can now cost tens of thousands.

Snowflake's pricing documentation shows how detailed this has become. 

The company splits AI usage onto a separate consumption meter so customers can track token spend against regular processing costs.

content_html_zh:
在过去两年的大部分时间里，投资者购买了几乎所有与半导体相关的公司，从芯片设计商到设备制造商，这些股票全面上涨。

另一方面，企业软件被视为附带损害，其定价就好像大型语言模型最终会使整个类别变得多余。

这一假设现在正在接受测试，而不是由软件公司本身进行测试。

Piper Sandler 周三告诉客户，五个基础设施软件名称旨在解决首席信息官抱怨最多的问题：大规模运行人工智能代理的成本远远超出任何人的预算。

Piper Sandler 的论点是，这些公司已经存储的客户数据可以减少人工智能代理需要处理的代币数量，从而降低运行成本。

为什么 Piper Sandler 说这 5 只软件股票降低了人工智能代币成本

据 Investing.com 报道，该报告由分析师 Rob Owens 主导，将 Elastic (ESTC)、GitLab (GTLB)、MongoDB (MDB)、Snowflake (SNOW) 和 Atlassian (TEAM) 列为主要受益者。

标记是通常小于单词的文本块。 人工智能模型按令牌收费，计算您发送的内容和返回的内容。

相关：人工智能正在悄然改变投资组合的管理方式

欧文斯写道，这些平台中已有的专有数据可以使模型“显着更加准确和高效，同时大幅降低代币使用成本”。

这将使企业扩大人工智能的采用，而成本不会增加太多。

早期部署显示，当将干净的组织上下文直接提供给代理时，令牌使用率会下降 50% 到 75%。

该机制非常简单。 当提供干净、有组织的数据而不是混乱的数据时，人工智能使用更少的标记并更快地回答。

2026 年改变企业人工智能预算的代币数学

这是今年让很多投资者感到困惑的部分：代币价格下跌，但人工智能费用却上涨了。

Owens 指出，较新前沿模型的输出代币比上一代便宜约 50%，但推理能力的提高导致消耗增加。

推理模型以标记进行思考，因此曾经花费数百标记的单个查询现在可能花费数万标记。

更多人工智能股票：

  • AMD 刚刚达成迄今为止最大的人工智能交易
  • 人工智能蜜月期因股票抛售而结束
  • 摩根士丹利对内存股做出强硬判决

Snowflake 的定价文档显示了这一点的详细程度。

该公司将人工智能的使用分配到一个单独的消耗计量表上，以便客户可以根据常规处理成本跟踪代币支出。
